name: Progress
whenToUse: A task with a known percent done: upload, restore, export, install.
A running task of unknown length (a deploy, a scan): `indeterminate`.
A known number of stages (“stage 3 of 5”): `segments`.

whenNotToUse.text: Content loading for the first time
A background task people shouldn’t wait on

anatomy.description: what is running — next to the bar and linked with `aria-labelledby`.
`value` 0–100, clamped; or a sweeping bar with `indeterminate`; or `segments` equal steps that fill one after another.
percent, or “3 of 12 sites”, or time left.

do.caption: What’s running and how much is done.
do.example: Restoring backup66%

dont.caption: A bare bar: progress of what?

do.caption: Content loading for the first time → a skeleton of it. (A task of unknown length that people watch, like a deploy, is Progress indeterminate.)

dont.caption: A fake percent for a page load lies about the wait.

a11y: Always named: `aria-labelledby` to the visible label, or `aria-label`.
Announce start and finish in a live region (or a toast); don’t announce every percent.
Indeterminate has no value: the label says what is running. Movement respects reduced motion — the sweep becomes a slow fade.

props.name: indeterminate
props.description: Unknown length: no value, a sweeping bar.

props.name: segments
props.description: Split the bar into this many steps (2 or more).
